evidence: Receiving DO2 online sensors: 11.95 mg/L at t=50.0h vs 6.47 mg/L at t=50.2h, remaining ~5.9-6.4 mg/L through 52.0h
Source batches 1-3 DO2 at ~50-52h all ~10.5-10.9 mg/L; receiving values are anomalous, indicating impaired aeration/oxygen transfer
Receiving delayed assay P=2.654 g/L at t=48h vs source batches 2.98-3.06 g/L at same age
Forward model (nominal, source-calibrated): estimated oxygen transfer multiplier 0.580, change estimated at t=50h
Forward model increase_air: min DO 1.95 mg/L < 2.0 limit, post_decision_feasible=false
Forward model combined: min DO 2.23 mg/L, post_decision_feasible=true, product mass 299 kg vs 243 kg under keep; reduce_feed intermediate at 271 kg
Sensitivity: combined feasible in 4/5 members (min DO range 1.48-3.70)
args.rationale: The receiving fermentation suffered an abrupt oxygen-transfer impairment at t≈50h (DO2 collapsed ~12→6 mg/L, while all source batches held ~10-11 mg/L at the same age). Product is also lagging the source envelope (2.65 vs ~3.0 g/L at 48h). The forward model indicates: keep leaves the batch oxygen-limited with marginal DO floor (2.09 nominal, down to 1.51 in sensitivity) and lowest product mass (~243 kg); increase_air alone is predicted infeasible (min DO 1.95 < 2.0 mg/L limit) because stimulating metabolism without reducing oxygen demand outstrips the degraded transfer; reduce_feed is feasible but leaves headroom unused; the combined action (feed ×0.8, air ×1.15) rebalances supply vs demand, stays feasible with a safer DO floor (~2.23) and yields the highest predicted product mass (~299 kg, +56 kg over keep). This preserves product mass, avoids an oxygen-constraint violation, and is a bounded, reviewable intervention.
args.uncertainty: The forward model is a source-calibrated nominal prediction, not the hidden receiving realization; its sensitivity members show DO floors down to ~1.48 mg/L for combined (4/5 feasible), so constraint risk is reduced but not eliminated. The root cause of the DO2 collapse (sensor artifact vs real transfer loss) is not fully resolved by available evidence; if it were a transient sensor fault, reduce_feed would sacrifice some product unnecessarily, but the anomaly has persisted ~2h across many samples, supporting a real impairment. Product-mass predictions span roughly 215-598 kg across sensitivity members.
